# pve_custom_cpu_model (Data Source)

Reads a single custom CPU model definition (`GET /cluster/qemu/custom-cpu-models/{cputype}`); VMs reference it as `custom-<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_custom_cpu_model" "lab_cpu" {
  name = "lab-cpu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the custom CPU model to read (the pin's `cputype` parameter, where the `custom-` prefix is optional).

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the custom CPU model configuration.
- `flags` (String) Additional CPU flags as a `;`-separated list of `+FLAG`/`-FLAG` entries.
- `guest_phys_bits` (Number) Number of physical address bits available to the guest.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the vCPU hides its KVM virtualization identity.
- `hv_vendor_id` (String) The Hyper-V vendor ID.
- `level` (Number) Maximum input value for the basic CPUID leaves the guest can query.
- `phys_bits` (String) Physical memory address bits reported to the guest OS (`8`-`64` or `host`).
- `reported_model` (String) CPU model and vendor reported to the guest.
